source_baseline.note: This is the inspected pre-handoff reference, not a claim that the repository HEAD has not advanced. TL must verify current HEAD before dispatch.

architecture.permitted_dependency_paths: web -> public @unicom/commerce contract.ts and web -> public @unicom/experience contract.ts/runtime/index.ts. experience -> commerce remains forbidden; web -> @unicom/agent remains forbidden.

operator_directive.source: Operator request: 'what final handoff to the TL' (2026-10-11)
operator_directive.authorization_basis: Prepare and hand off bounded, non-live product-completion work within the existing frozen architecture. This does not authorize architecture changes, commerce-plane linking, production deployment/mutation, live provider use or human research.
operator_directive.scope: W1-013 canonical build evidence; W2-014 J12 B2B rendered-flow gaps; W3-017 J16 local camera/QR and accessible fallback; TL-owned decision packets only for gated integration questions.

policy.dispatch_gate: Verify current default-branch HEAD and baseline before dispatch; no further chat authorization required for the three bounded non-live work orders in the handoff.
policy.canonical_build_policy: Canonical build PASS requires the unchanged canonical configuration to succeed with measured >=3 GB free memory. The prior --sourcemap false variant is not canonical-pass evidence.

work_orders.required_evidence: Exact command/commit/tool versions, actual memory floor >=3 GB, runtime, duration, exit code, output inventory, hashes and immutable logs. Build-only workflow if needed; no deploy.

work_orders.dependency: Existing public contracts; inspect gap map before editing; no shared-shell or kernel refactor.
work_orders.required_evidence: Contract-to-UI map; role/permission paths; lane tests; real-browser evidence of newly completed rendered interactions; visibly labeled demo/unavailable boundaries.

work_orders.dependency: Existing physical-store flow; any new QR-decoder dependency requires TL review; no new architecture edge.
work_orders.required_evidence: User-initiated camera flow; denied/unsupported/manual fallback; media-track cleanup; local decode; no image bytes over network or into storage/telemetry; browser evidence.

tl_owned_decision_packets.detail: Consider safely linking formed GroupBuys/executed TradeCycles to downstream orders/payments/reservations/recourse. Preserve consent, actor authority, idempotency, rollback/compensation, UNKNOWN and explicit side-effect authorization.
Assess browser-safe connector runtime display while isolating Node-only code and respecting frozen public-entrypoint/module graph. No new sub-entrypoint/export until operator approval.

acceptance_gates.name: Current default-branch head, clean baseline and frozen-architecture boundary verified
Canonical production build succeeds with measured >=3 GB free memory and evidence
Declared J12 interactive gaps closed within existing contracts and real-browser verified
Local camera/QR workflow and accessible fallback verified; no media transmission
Relevant full test suite, lint, architecture check and scoped TypeScript checks pass
Merged real-Chromium gate passes with zero drift, full evidence pointers and valid manifest
Consent, role/actor authority, UNKNOWN semantics, idempotency, demo labeling and no-side-effect tripwires pass
Independent TL verification, final report, evidence manifests and current state updated

closeout_rule: Do not close issue #12 or report release readiness complete while the canonical build gate is blocked or unproven. Preserve blockers and evidence history without changing denominators to manufacture green status.
